changelog: Web UI tunnel: retry a dropped connection on a brand-new socket instead of the pooled one. These miners handle keep-alive inconsistently, so a socket the pool believes is reusable can already be dead at the miner's end — every request handed to it failed the same way, which is what left strings.properties and strings_en.properties returning 502 and every label on the dashboard showing as [rate], [network] and so on
Web UI tunnel: discard a miner's whole connection pool after the first dropped connection, so other queued requests don't inherit a socket already proven dead
Web UI tunnel: log the real error code for a failed miner request rather than just reporting a generic 502
